faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Magistrate Office, Narmada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Magistrate Office, Narmada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies for Additional Public Prosecutor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Magistrate Office, Narmada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Office websites https://narmada.gujarat.gov.in/ and https://narmada.nic.in/) and send it to Office of the District Magistrate, Narmada - Rajpipla, by speed post only, to reach by 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is not below 30 years and not above 55 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fee and other allowances as per the Gujarat Prosecuting Officers (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Affairs Rules, 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Law graduate, active as an advocate for at least seven years, and an income tax payer for at least 3 years before appointment.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must have been active as an advocate for at least seven years. Must have been an income tax payer for at least 3 years before appointment.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointees can perform duties up to a maximum age of 60 years. Panel prepared under Section 18(4) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and the State's 2026 Prosecuting Officers Rules.
